# Product-owner constraints (NON-NEGOTIABLE — these are not findings, do not argue them)

Stated by the product owner (nalyk), 2026-11-09, translated from Romanian:

1. It starts as a HOBBY project; it WILL go live later, but later.
2. NO MVP. The target is FULL-FEATURED: every system and sub-feature in the blueprint (see §31 coverage audit of
   02_BLUEPRINT_original_kamael.md) must exist. ALL code will be written by AI (Claude Opus class models and similar).
   Estimates in person-days / man-months are therefore meaningless and must not be used as arguments.
3. NOTHING is postponed/deferred. If something looks infeasible or premature, find a real solution — not a deferral.
4. At most 10 human testers during the hobby period.
5. Chronicle changed: target is L2J Mobius **CT 2.6 High Five** (`L2J_Mobius_CT_2.6_HighFive`), NOT Classic 3.0 Kamael
   (the blueprint was written for Kamael; its philosophy is kept, its Kamael-specific facts are not).
6. Debate rules: reach real CONSENSUS. No workarounds. No "MVP", no "phase 0 / phase 1" scope cutting.
   Both debaters are FORBIDDEN from being superficial: every claim needs evidence (file:line in the Mobius source,
   blueprint section, URL) or explicit reasoning. Ordering work by hard technical dependency is allowed;
   ordering by priority/cutting scope is not.
